# Load Libraries
```{r}
library(readxl)
library(tidyverse)
source("_config.r")
```

# Load data
```{r}
# Load both excel sheets for bryophytes data
header <- read_excel(file.path(DATA_ROOT, "bdm/raw/2050_Z9_Kopfdaten_V3.xlsx"), sheet = 1)
header # Size 7'289 X 16
moss <- read_excel(file.path(DATA_ROOT, "bdm/raw/2050_Z9_Moose_V3.xlsx"), sheet = 1)
moss # Size 65'155 x 6
```

# Preprocess data
## Merge "Art" column
```{r}
# Merge datasets based on "aID_KD" keeping all surveys from "header" and throw out false surveys
data <- left_join(header, moss, by = "aID_KD")
data <- as_tibble(data) |>
  filter(!is.na(yearMoos)) # Throw out false surveys with NA values in "yearMoos" column

# Change the column name "Art" to "Artepitheton"
colnames(data)[which(names(data) == "Art")] <- "Artepitheton"

# Add the strings from column "Gattung" and "Artepitheton" together into column "Art"
data <- data |>
  mutate(Art = if_else(is.na(Gattung) & is.na(Artepitheton), NA_character_, paste(Gattung, Artepitheton)))
```

## Key data overview
```{r}
# Get data type of "data" dataframe
str(data)

# Get dataframe dimensions
dim(data) # Size 66'108 X 22 

# Check all columns for NaN values and print the amount of NaN values per column
sapply(data, function(x) sum(is.na(x)))

# Count and print the amount of unique plots in "aID_STAO"
print(paste("Number of unique plots (aID_STAO):", n_distinct(data$aID_STAO))) # 1442 Plots

# Count and print the amount of unique species in "Art"
print(paste("Number of unique species (Art):", n_distinct(data$Art))) # 575 Species + 1 NA value

# Print a summary of the dataframe
summary(data)
data
```

## Save unique species list
```{r}
# Create a list of unique species in "Art" column, but ignore the one NA value
species_list <- unique(data$Art[!is.na(data$Art)])

# Sort them according to alphabetical order
species_list <- species_list[order(species_list)]

# Save the species list as a csv file
write.csv(species_list, file = file.path(DATA_ROOT, "bdm/processed/moss_species_list.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

## Data cropping
```{r}
# Select only columns needed for analysis
data_cropped <- data |>
  select(aID_STAO, yearMoos, Art)
```

## Calculate yearly richness per plot (alpha diversity)
```{r}
# Count species occurrences per plot and year by grouping "aID_STAO" and "yearMoos" and fill NA with 0
alpha_richness <- data_cropped |>
  group_by(aID_STAO, yearMoos) |> # Group according to year and ID
  summarize(richness_moss = n_distinct(Art, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") # Summarize all unique species, NA becomes 0
alpha_richness

# Print the plots and survey year with no species found
alpha_richness_zero <- alpha_richness |>
  filter(richness_moss == 0)
alpha_richness_zero # 955 surveys with richness = 0
```

## Saving resulting dataframe as rds file
```{r}
# Save the alpha_richness dataframe as a rds file
saveRDS(alpha_richness, file = PATH_MOSS_RICHNESS)
```
